blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden post set into a low ring of mossy cobblestones. The post is topped with a carved, lobed spherical wooden finial. Hanging off one side is a coiled loop of yellow-brown rope, and protruding from the opposite side near the top is a curved dark metal hook. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with hand-painted textures and clean geometry, sitting securely and flat on the ground.
blind.from_above: A segmented round cap resembling a small pumpkin or peeled citrus fruit, flanked by the textured loop of yellow rope on one side and a small dark metal hook jutting out on the other, over the wider circle of stone blocks at the base.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: mossy stone ring base built into the model
blind.height_vs_figure: About 55% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about 1.3 feet wide at the stone base.
